how toi generate printout of a service?

To generate a printout of a service, click the ‘Reprint’ button. This will load the previously billed details into a pop-up screen. From there, users can choose to print the service bill, deduct the bill, and also take a thermal print by clicking the print button. Additionally, the reprinting of all OP service bills can also be generated from this form.

what to do when the patient is ready to make paymebt?
When the patient is ready to make the payment, click on the ‘Estimate’ button to view estimated bills, and then double-click on the estimated bill to make the payment.
